# Cosmic Mesh Net

> Sovereign, deterministic, Bitcoin-anchored provenance mesh.
> No telemetry. No PII. No commercial rails. All claims are hash-verifiable.

## Doctrine
- [Universal Justice Manifesto · Sovereign Runtime Declaration](https://cosmic-mesh-net.lovable.app/) — SHA-256 `8c426dc6…fa45`, anchored Bitcoin block 955889.
- Universal Justice Addendum v1 — SHA-256 `d9b7816a…6834`, OTS submitted to alice/bob/finney calendars 2026-06-29, pending Bitcoin inclusion.

## Architecture
- [/ops](https://cosmic-mesh-net.lovable.app/ops) — Final Manifest, Mesh Health, Provenance Receipts, Receipt Wizard.
- [/verify](https://cosmic-mesh-net.lovable.app/verify) — offline receipt verification (paste OTS).
- [/digital-ore](https://cosmic-mesh-net.lovable.app/digital-ore) — local-only intellectual-byproduct ledger. Hash-deterministic. No payout rail.
- [/truth-coin](https://cosmic-mesh-net.lovable.app/truth-coin) — Truth Substrate (TRS) provenance tile.
- [/pam](https://cosmic-mesh-net.lovable.app/pam) — SOURCE&TRUTH persona spec.

## Provenance
- 11/14 SHAs anchored to Bitcoin (blocks 955889, 955894, 955897, 955967, 955974).
- Golden Truth CID: recomputed deterministically from `terminus-ops.json` via `scripts/build-manifest.mjs`.
- 3 SHAs PENDING calendar inclusion (`ad6ca928…`, `1b5e90e1…`, `d9b45f92…`).

## Boundaries
- No third-party analytics or trackers.
- No PII collection.
- No payment processing. DOU is a local-only accounting unit, not currency.
- No legal claim of sovereignty status; doctrine documents are speech, Bitcoin anchors are timestamps.
